name: n8n-contract-test-runner
description: Standalone offline-capable contract-conformance gate for the n8n Workflow-as-Code portfolio: parses each project's docs/workflow-contract.md '## Machine-readable contract' block and asserts request/response shape against the deployed workflow JSON + fixtures. Offline (CI) by default; opt-in -Live re-POSTs golden requests behind a 404/connection SKIP gate.
